description: This file defines the PageSettings class in the PhpSpreadsheet library, responsible for reading and applying page layout and style settings from an ODS (OpenDocument Spreadsheet) document. It handles parsing style information from the DOM, cross-referencing styles, and configuring worksheet page setup accordingly.

classes.name: PageSettings
classes.description: Handles reading and applying page layout styles and settings from an ODS document DOM, including style cross-referencing and applying page setup and margins to worksheets.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes PageSettings instance by setting namespace URIs and reading style data from the DOM document.

methods.name: setDomNameSpaces
methods.description: Sets namespace URIs for office, style, fo, and table from the DOM document.

methods.name: readPageSettingStyles
methods.description: Parses page layout styles, extracting properties such as orientation, scale, margins, and header/footer spacing, and stores them internally.

methods.name: readStyleMasterLookup
methods.description: Reads master style references and maps style names to page layout names.

methods.name: readStyleCrossReferences
methods.description: Establishes cross-references for styles and table styles, determining visibility and page layout associations.

methods.name: setVisibilityForWorksheet
methods.description: Sets worksheet visibility based on style cross-reference.

methods.name: setPrintSettingsForWorksheet
methods.description: Applies page setup configurations such as orientation, scale, margins, and page order to the worksheet based on style cross-reference.
